name: What should I consider when comparing offers for my property?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when comparing offers for my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: When comparing offers, look beyond just the price. Evaluate the buyer's financing strength (pre-approval vs. pre-qualification), contingency clauses (e.g., inspection, appraisal, sale of their current home), and proposed closing timeline. A higher offer with extensive contingencies might be riskier than a slightly lower, cleaner offer with solid financing. Kelby Contreras helps you thoroughly analyze each offer's terms and conditions, providing strategic advice to select the best option for your situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare offers by considering price, buyer financing strength, contingencies, and closing timeline. Kelby Contreras helps analyze terms to select the best option.
